title: Good clean burn.
text: Good clean burn.. Came in a box that was on the thin side and the one side of the candles were smashed in a bit.. The little metal holders were dented in as if the box was dropped but the candle wax itself was not damaged much..other than little crumbs that came off. I put the crumbs back on the candle wax and it burned just fine. They have a nice clean burn on the wick. No smoke at all !! Nice little candle.
